channel.title: BRG Financial Insights
channel.description: Plain-English articles on investing and retirement from BRG Financial.

item.title: The Real Cost of Waiting: Why Investing in Your 20s Changes Everything
item.description: A dollar invested at 25 does work a dollar invested at 35 simply can’t catch up to. Here’s the math, in plain English, and what to actually do about it.

item.title: How Much Does a Financial Advisor Actually Cost? A Plain-English Breakdown
item.description: Percentage-of-assets, flat, hourly, commission — the fee models explained, plus the questions that reveal what you’re really paying.

item.title: Roth vs. Traditional: Which Account Wins for You?
item.description: The decision comes down to one question about your tax rate — today versus in retirement. Here’s how to think it through.

item.title: Offering a 401(k) at Your Small Business: A Straightforward Guide
item.description: A retirement plan can attract talent and cut your tax bill — without the administrative headache you’re picturing. Here’s how it actually works.

item.title: The 5 Most Common 401(k) Rollover Mistakes (and How to Avoid Them)
item.description: A rollover is usually simple — but a few wrong turns can cost you taxes, penalties, or years of growth. Here are the mistakes we see most, and the clean way through.

item.title: How Much Cash Should You Actually Keep? Emergency Funds, Explained
item.description: Too little cash and one bad month becomes debt. Too much and inflation quietly taxes you. Here’s how to find the right number — and where to park it.
